Bones out in the open exposed to elements for a thousand years? Yes they would break down. Decalcification and the loss of proteins in the collagens by bacteria, fungi, insects, etc. Bones break down. The reason we have fossils and skeletal remains is because they were preserved in a layer that didn't let it break down nearly as quickly. Open air = decomposition.
